svg.text: Apex Scaffold 基础设施组件架构
• 配置中心 (动态配置推送)
• 消息持久化 & 事务消息
[Layer 3] 监控可观测层 Monitoring & Observability
• JVM / 应用 / 业务指标
[Layer 4] 网关负载均衡层 Gateway & Load Balancing
• 路径路由 & 反向代理
• 服务发现 & 负载均衡
• 静态资源 CDN 加速
• Master 节点 (3 HA) + Worker 节点 (3+)
[Layer 6] CI/CD 流水线 Continuous Integration & Deployment
• Maven 测试 + JaCoCo 覆盖率
🔄 关键数据流向 Key Data Flows
1️⃣ 用户请求: CloudFlare CDN → Nginx Ingress → K8s Service → Apex App (3 Pods)
2️⃣ 数据读写: Apex App → Druid Pool → MySQL Primary (写) / MySQL Replica (读)
3️⃣ 缓存查询: Apex App → Redisson Client → Redis Cluster (6 nodes) + Caffeine L1 Cache
4️⃣ 消息队列: Apex App → RocketMQ Producer → NameServer → Broker → Consumer
5️⃣ 监控遥测: Apex App → Prometheus Pull (/actuator/prometheus) → Grafana Dashboard
6️⃣ 链路追踪: Apex App → Zipkin Reporter (HTTP) → Zipkin Server → UI 可视化
